panels.description: Per time bucket, unions issue creation events (by creator) and DONE resolution events (by assignee) and counts each side.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT i.created_date AS ts, 1 AS opened, 0 AS closed
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter( i.created_date ) 
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.resolution_date, 0, 1
  FROM issues i
  
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter( i.created_date ) 
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
  AND i.status = 'DONE'
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $interval)                                        AS time,
       SUM(opened)                                                   AS Opened,
       SUM(closed)                                                   AS Closed
FROM ev
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Created VS Closed Trend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(i.created_date, $interval)     AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'BUG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Bugs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'TASK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Tasks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'STORY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Stories,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'SUBTASK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Sub Tasks`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT i.type                                        AS type,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.priority), ''), '(none)')   AS priority,
         i.lead_time_minutes / 1440.0                       AS days
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.status = 'DONE'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0
    AND i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT type, priority, days,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY type, priority ORDER BY days) AS cd
  FROM d
)
SELECT type AS Type,
       priority AS Priority,
       COUNT(*)                                            AS `Total Issues`,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN days END), 1)  AS `Median Days`,
       ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.75 THEN days END), 1)  AS `P75 Days`
FROM ranked
GROUP BY type, priority
HAVING `Total Issues` >= 3
ORDER BY type, `Median Days` DESC;

panels.description: Lists in progress tickets not updated in over 14 days with their assignee and days since the last update.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.assignee_name AS Developer, 
  i.title AS Issue,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) AS `Lead Time Days`,
  i.url AS URL
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) > 14
  AND $__timeFilter(i.updated_date) 
  AND i.assignee_id IN ($developer_id )
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
ORDER BY `Lead Time Days` DESC

list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id like 'jira:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY pm.project_name

SELECT CONCAT(b.name, '--', b.id) AS text
FROM project_mapping pm
JOIN boards b ON b.id = pm.row_id
WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND pm.project_name IN ( $project )
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  SELECT ia.assignee_id AS account_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.creator_id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.creator_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT ic.author_id
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT w.author_id
  FROM issue_worklogs w
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = w.issue_id
  WHERE w.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name;
